blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Did Vice President Sara Duterte’s tree-planting activities have anything to do with a requirement imposed on Cale88 Foods Corporation, the banana chip company linked to her husband, Manases Carpio? This was the question raised by a prosecution lawyer during Friday’s impeachment trial, as the defense presented Trade Undersecretary Ceferino Rodolfo as a witness. Prosecution counsel Erwin Matib asked Rodolfo whether he knew if Duterte’s tree-planting activities were connected to a Board of Investments (BOI) requirement for enterprises to plant at least 100 forest trees to qualify for incentives.
